payload.abstract: The aim of the PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2011 is to develop an efficient algorithm able to run in near real-time within a mobile phone, that can provide useful feedback to a layperson in the process of acquiring a diagnostically useful ECG recording.

payload.title: Improving the Quality of ECGs Collected using Mobile Phones: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2011
